meta.title: LLM & API Call Map
meta.authoredFrom: Manual codebase audit of gateway/ and chatbot/ (see dashboard/README.md)
meta.notes: Every LLM call in this project funnels through one of the choke points below, so per-request recording needs exactly one hook per subsystem. The capture pipeline fires up to 6 LLM calls per transcript chunk (context_manager first, then explanation/technical/analyst/risk in parallel, then response) plus one summary call at meeting end. The chatbot fires 1-4 calls per question depending on the RAG path taken.

llm.modelNote: gpt-5.6-luna is locked in the gateway (no override) and rejects temperature overrides, so neither client sends temperature. Token cap goes through max_completion_tokens.

chokePoints.description: Single choke point for ALL capture-pipeline LLM calls. Retries 429/5xx/timeouts with exponential backoff, emits llm_latency_ms metrics. Every success and final failure is persisted to llm_usage.db.
PRIMARY chatbot adapter (CHATBOT_LLM_ADAPTER=openai, the default). Budget gating via CallCountBudgetGuard, 2 retries, lenient JSON parsing. Reads completion.usage and persists every call.
ALTERNATIVE adapter (CHATBOT_LLM_ADAPTER=langchain) using LangChain ChatOpenAI. Token usage is extracted from response_metadata/usage_metadata and persisted.
NATIVE RUST choke point for Tauri desktop meeting agents (context_manager, explanation, technical, analyst, risk_detector, response_agent). Records latency, prompts, tokens, and cost to llm_usage.db.

callSites.purpose: Tracks the live meeting topic, maintains a rolling summary, extracts glossary terms and grades chunk significance (none|low|medium|high). Its output gates the other agents.
Plain-language breakdown of the chunk for non-technical listeners.
Detailed technical explanation of complex topics in the chunk.
Extracts concrete decisions and action items (assignee + deadline) as JSON.
Detects risks, blockers and concerns with category + severity as JSON.
Formulates a contextual suggested reply with an intent tag ([ANSWER]/[QUESTION]/[DECISION]).

callSites.invokedBy: DISABLED — not wired into the pipeline (saves LLM calls)
callSites.purpose: Would clean/normalize raw STT text before analysis. Currently dormant.

callSites.invokedBy: generateMeetingSummary() at meeting end (gateway/lifecycle/shutdown.js), 12s deadline race vs fallback template
callSites.purpose: Executive Big-4-style meeting summary (6 fixed markdown sections) from full history + artifacts + risks.

callSites.invokedBy: LangGraph node 'analyze_query' (first node of every chat question)
callSites.purpose: Converts the user question into safe FTS5 keywords and flags ambiguity. Degrades to naive keyword extraction if the LLM fails.
Grades retrieved meeting snippets for relevance to the question (returns relevant indices).

callSites.invokedBy: LangGraph node 'rewrite_query' (corrective loop when grading finds nothing, max 2 rewrites)
callSites.purpose: Rewrites the search keywords when the first retrieval attempt missed.

callSites.invokedBy: LangGraph conditional edge when the question is ambiguous
callSites.purpose: Shows what was found and asks ONE clarifying question.
Generates the grounded answer with [M#] meeting citations from the graded evidence.

otherApis.name: AssemblyAI
otherApis.note: Billed per audio minute, not per token — intentionally NOT recorded in llm_usage.db. Orchestrated by gateway/stt/provider-manager.js.

otherApis.name: Speechmatics
otherApis.note: Failover target when AssemblyAI errors; same normalized event contract. Also billed per audio minute.
